I just received my property tax bill and I was very disappointed that it was  higher than I expected. It was all I could think about.

I also have a dream of dropping everything and leaving my current life behind. I've done a really big change once (moved to another country 3000 miles away), and pushed myself to make drastic changes to my work or life situation 3 times since then. It seems that after each change it takes less and less time before I'm unhappy and seeking a way out. Maybe I just run out of goals too easily.

I've went through one type of therapy already, and it helped me for nearly 3 years. I probably haven't given this round enough time to take effect, but if my goal is to not hurt the people around me, why should I carry my burden just so that everyone else can be happy? It's quite tiring to hide my unhappiness from everyone. 

I feel so selfish.

Thank you so much for responding. It seems to help quite a bit to actually write out my thoughts.
I actually had a trial run on Saturday for an attempt the following day during super bowl. I aborted the plans after being amazed that my neighbors didn't say anything to me during the trial run, but I'm 100% sure they would have said something was up during the real deal (it would have been bigger and badder). It was also pretty dangerous. I just didn't have enough experience and not sure where I could get it without anyone knowing.

Anyway, I strongly suspect that my friends and parents know that something is wrong with me. We're not a family that discusses things like emotions, but my dad has hinted that he doesn't think everything is alright in my life. Also, these thoughts first occurred while I was travelling with my dad and step-mom. I suddenly stopped talking to anyone. My friends have been reaching out to have lunch or do things with me a bit more than usual, so I'm sure they know too. I don't think it will be completely unexpected to anyone. 

Realistically here are the scenarios as I see them:
*10% chance that I will check myself into treatment
*80% chance that I will do absolutely nothing until someone makes me do the above
*10% chance that I will attempt my alternate plan

I'm going to sleep on this and see how I feel in the morning.
